# The initial manual-config required flag does not reach the internal input

In the initial phase, the form assigns required on an AccountHubInput host. That historical class has no required setter and copies its initial required attribute only when connecting. The assignment changes a host property; the checkbox/reset tests read that same property and do not establish the internal input constraint. The accepted class later adds a setter that reflects the attribute and changes the internal input. This is a bounded static receiver and test-coverage finding, not an observed validation failure. The checkbox path already used this property before the new prefill helper.

Scope: Account Hub manual configuration and AccountHubInput.
